# Generated data — do not edit by hand

Everything in this folder is written by `npm run data` (see [`docs/content.md`](../../../docs/content.md)).
To change what the game teaches, edit [`src/data/curriculum.ts`](../curriculum.ts) and run it again.

## Sources and licences

These files are derived from open data, and they carry those licences:

| Data | From | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meanings, genders, forms, synonyms, regional labels, usage notes (`words.json`, `verbs.json` English, `dictionary.json`) | [English Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org), as packaged by [doozan/spanish_data](https://github.com/doozan/spanish_data) | [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) |
| Example sentences, word-order sentences and grammar drills (`sentences.json`, `drills.json`, `ex` in `words.json`) | [Tatoeba](https://tatoeba.org) — each sentence keeps its author credit in `src` / `exSrc` | [CC BY 2.0 FR](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/fr/) |
| Word frequencies used to rank and filter | [FrequencyWords](https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords) (OpenSubtitles) | CC BY-SA 4.0 |
| Verb conjugations (`verbs.json` forms) | [conjugate-esp](https://github.com/jirimracek/conjugate-esp) | MIT |

Because of the share-alike terms, this folder (and anything else derived from it) is available
under CC BY-SA 4.0. `meta.json` records the exact source commit.
